## What & why

Brief description of the change and the motivation behind it.

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] `test` — adding/fixing tests
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, deps, CI

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`pytest -v`)
- [ ] New functionality is covered by tests
- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](../CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-conventions)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior/config/API changed (`README.md`, `docs/*.md`)

## Related issue(s)

Closes #
